extracted.summary: A national level scholarship for girl students from minority communities, that is Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Parsi.
extracted.amount_text: For Classes 9 and 10: INR 10,000 annually, which will be released in two instalments of INR 5,000 for each student quarterly. For Classes 11 and 12: INR 12,000 annually, which will be released in two instalments of INR 6,000 for each student quarterly.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have secured at least 50% marks or equivalent grades in aggregate in the previous class.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual family income of the candidate must not be more than INR 2 Lakh from all sources.
extracted.categories_quote: The applicant must belong to one of the six notified minority communities.
extracted.genders_quote: A national level scholarship for girl students from minority communities, that is Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Parsi.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants studying in classes 9 to 12 can apply.
